Photo Credits: Stuart Seeger
"At Patonomics They do not 'Search', They FIND"....
             I am not sure if I could ever appreciate the services which I used to get (earlier) from globally known European, American & Asian service providers" 
             
Global IP Director from one of the most globally respected Swedish Brand
            
"We believe that you are the best partner to write this report (Invalidation). We do not have a strict dead-line. Focus is on having a complete report."
            
CTO from European multinational (world leader) company
            
"I am really excited to work with you, after knowing your believe system and for what you stand for. I do not know why my excitement is not coming out from body right now. I want to send you a work immediately.
            
After checking your work with your Novelty killing prior art, which was already won many rewards by national and regional government as most important innovations of our times, I must say I respect you and want to work with you in future on a regular basis, so we can avoid investing in technologies that’s drain out our critical resources."
            
Joint CEO – Nation’s most respected technology-based Incubator 
            
"We consider Patonomics's work as very through and qualified. They has a large capacity in multiple fields and so far we are satisfied with their work and reports."
            
Incubator Manager – European most oldest & most successful Incubator
            
"All my life I wanted to be an entrepreneur, but I never had the courage to start as getting lavish salary and comfortable life. I respect you. I am really excited to work with you, after knowing your belief system and for what you stand for. I want to provide you minimum 1000 novelty analysis per year to your firm and ready to pay minimum 25% more than I am paying my present vendor for your quality and commitment standard. I will give you time so you can recruit your team slowly and build up you business. I am really happy for you. What do you say?"
            
VP Legal Affairs for Development (Global Head of IP) from one of the most globally respected European Brand
            
"I had the pleasure to work with Mr. Kalyan Mitra from Patonomics on several IP-Strategy issues. His input was extremely important and gave the opportunity to leverage our IP in a completely different dimension. Mr Mitra is very thorough in his work. I can highly recommend Mr. Mitra and Patonomics for any IP-related search, strategy and valuation work."
            
Director IP & Business from European multinational company
           
"I knew Kalyan Mitra of Patonomics over many years in close corporate interactions and when I needed to comb the world in our technology area for technology, product, market, regulation, I had no one better than Kalyan to depend on. His team’s report help us to convince our National Multi-year R&D funding directors at the ministry to provide us unquestionable support for our internationally challenged  product development first time in this world. I am happy recommending Patonomics anyone who wants to avoid REINVENTING and escaping from well known marketing and regulatory traps."
            
CTO, Canadian company that successfully developed a giant engineering product with complex technologies to that nobody succeed before.
            
"The quality of the work was highly satisfactory. Patonomics delivered a result which was unquestionable and of high value for our study. The high quality, trustability and accuracy make me happy to recommend Patonomics to anyone in need of expert intellectual property consultancy services."
            
Head Strategic Business Unit, European multinational (world leader) company
            
"I consulted Patonomics to give me opinion on Freedom to Operate (FTO) on certain areas in the agro-biotechnology sector. I found them to be very knowledgeable and experienced with the FTO studies and IP analysis. I was very satisfied with the conclusion on FTO study."
            
Founder, Director & CEO of an Indian company
            
"You bring surprising Prior Art, which we all miss out. I used to feel proud having strong knowledge and skills in patent search for many years, and even myself could not find that Prior Art. We used services from top search firms from USA, Europe and Japan, without any results. I am happy recommending you to others."

pages.title: Patonomics
pages.main_text_excerpt:
KALYAN MITRA 
		
        
    
 Kalyan conceived & founded Patonomics Group in 2006. Kalyan is an ‘ethical information detective’ (FIND out almost any information that is legally accessible). His core passion is in all kind of technologies and associated businesses that are regulated by patent law. 
He works with decision makers at world leading brands. He and his team brings optimism and positivity in patent evaluation and valuation. He empower his clients 'Not to get scared by bullying patent owners', with empathy. He helps his clients to invalidate competitor’s patents that should not been granted by the patent offices around the world. Especially where his clients had failed to invalidate those patents after exhausting their in-house and global external resources under their reach. He is involved into technology licensing and associated M&A.
Kalyan started his career in early 1993 and has in depth experience in R&D and IP aspects of Mechanical, Chemical and Electrical industries as an employee, before starting Patonomics Group in 2006 from Göteborg, Sweden. He also had brief exposures in Environmental and ICT industries. Earlier he has been global IP head for Indian engineering multinational ‘Crompton Greaves Ltd’ that have global operations in all continents for product development, manufacturing, sales and service function. 
He draws immense pleasure to FIND from obscure information sources, where others had failed. As far as his memory goes, he was most wanted person at his home since his childhood days to FIND things when everyone at home is desperate to find something but could not trace it. 
His curiosity & experimenting nature have helped him to study engineering, business, intellectual property law, library and information science formally in different universities, and informally psychology, economics, geology and many others. Presently, Kalyan is updating his skills & knowledge in biotechnology at the local university to satisfy his curiosity in molecular trace of human behavior. In spare time Kalyan loves to wonder around nature, and involve in extreme sports. 
    
    RAKHI BISWAS
		
Rakhi, Co-founder-Patonomics group. She is a fashion designer and active with us from 2024. 
		
YOGITA PARAB
		
 Yogita Parab, Co-founder-Patonomics group is active with Patonomics since 2007.  
Deep investigating till FIND accurate information & establish crystal clear results is her passion and forte.  Her navigation skills reserve no sub-domain of science and technology as un-parsable.  Apart from delivering mind blowing results in invalidation cases, techno-commercial analysis of inventions and patentability validation assignments, she also plays a role of advisor to budding entrepreneurs and academic inventors.  She had been invited as a resource person in IP awareness training sessions for Gujarat Technological University faculty and by SMEs in Maharashtra.           
Her illustrious professional career before joining Patonomics includes affiliation with Indian top research institutes like Tata Institute of Fundamental Research, Tata Institute of Social Sciences, Indian Institute of Technology Bombay, and Corporate R&D of Crompton Greaves Ltd.  Role may be any, be a student or a trainee or a professional, she is always known for her dedication, dependability, deliverables and willingness to walk an extra mile to achieve nothing but the best.  
By formal training she holds post graduate degrees in physical science, information science and national scholarship based special training in patents/IPR, from Dept of S&T, Govt of India.  
She loves to explore about alternative medicine / therapy, Ayurveda, and experiment with healthy & quick cooking.  Teaching to create concept clarity, reading, solving puzzles, and being with nature in solitude are her relaxation engagements.
